topic: Impact of Rural Immersion on Youth Volunteers
questionText:
Read the following case study on youth community mobilization and social development and answer the questions that follow:

A contingent of 50 college student volunteers from the National Service Scheme (NSS) organizes a 7-day residential community camp in an adopted rural village. 2. Health and Nutrition Awareness: Volunteers conduct door-to-door surveys, screen children for growth faltering, and organize a street play (Nukkad Natak) on anemia.
